threads.body: With `-PdenyUnsafe=true`, the existing block at lines 79–82 disables the new `unitTests` task, silently skipping the three migrated helper test classes in the Java 25 deny-unsafe CI job. These tests run without the agent and do not receive its Unsafe-denial JVM arguments. Replace `withType<Test>().configureEach` in that block with `named<Test>("test")` so only the installed-agent test task is disabled.

replies.body: Fixed in 7122a90d6228. The `denyUnsafe` skip now applies only to the default installed-agent `test` execution. The migrated `unitTests` suite stays enabled and remains part of `check`.
